title: 第15章 挑选武技第16章 修炼无影针
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
苍云门传功堂位于宗门议事大厅的右侧，相隔百来米左右。
传功堂大门左右两侧各有一个威武庄严的石狮子，传功堂大门呈灰黑色，由纯铁铸就而成。
大门正上方高高挂着牌匾，黑字黄底，龙飞凤舞般写着三个大字：“传功堂。”
给人一种庄严肃穆的气氛。
通过大门，进入传功堂内，沿着走廊行走二十来米，入眼是一座五层高塔楼。
塔楼是由坚硬的花岗石建成，窗户处安装一排铁棍，以便透气。
如果想凭借高超轻功从窗户进入传功楼，是万万不行的，只能从大楼的正门进入。
林潜站在传功楼下，抬头仰望传功楼，一脸惊叹。
林潜刚入门的时候就远远看到了这个塔楼，当时就大为震惊。
现在近距离观看，顿感自身之渺小。
门口处一张木桌，后面坐着一位面色红润的老者，正慢悠悠的喝着茶。
每一个从其身边路过的弟子，都会拿出自己的身份铭牌给老者观看，确认无误后，才恭敬的走进传功楼。
林潜深吸一口气，来到大门口，林潜学着其他弟子，恭敬的递出了自己身份铭牌。
“嗯，炼药堂学徒？你是炼药堂学徒，跑来这里做什么？”
看着林潜递过来的铭牌，老者双眼一凝，疑惑问道。
“是的，弟子是炼药堂学徒，但也是外门弟子，因此也想学门武技傍身。”
林潜恭敬回答道。
老者有些好奇道：“你不好好的学医、制药，还跑来这里学武？”
“学医、练武都需要花费大量时间练习，你学得过来吗？”
“弟子主要还是学医，只是有时候需要放松一下，就想着来这里看看有没有合适的武技，放松的时候练练，缓解心情，还能强身健体，延年益寿。”

林潜看着老者，一脸认真的道。
“那你进去瞧瞧吧。”
听见林潜这么说，老者也不再多问了。
主要是老者看林潜这么年轻，又是学医又是练武，担心他不是时间管理大师，最后不仅医术没学好，连武技也没练好，落得一场空，白白浪费了青春。
炼药堂虽说以治病、疗伤、制药为主，其实也有一些医师会一些武技，用于自保。
而炼药堂的刘堂主更是其中的佼佼者，不仅医术高超，武道修为也是不弱其他堂主，甚至还占有上风。
......
此地书架不多，只有七八个的样子。
上面零零散散的摆放着一本本秘籍，粗略看去有几十本。
想来也正常，只是县城附近的门派，能有这么多武技已经很不错了。
这些武技还是宗门历年不断从各处搜集来的，不然还没这么多。
也有部分秘籍是弟子献给宗门，宗门自然也不会白白拿弟子的东西，可以让弟子从宗门里选一本相当的武学秘籍或者给钱财或者给修炼武道的药剂。
林潜随意的拿起一本秘籍看了起来，发现书架上的这些秘籍其实都没有招式及修炼方法，只有武技名称、武技招式及介绍武技的优缺点。
只有等弟子真正选定秘籍后，才会拿出真正的修炼秘籍给弟子。
林潜开始在这些书架之间转悠起来，时而拿起剑类武技，时而拿起刀类秘籍翻看，看着里面五花八门的秘籍，每一本秘籍他都很心动，恨不得全部学了。
尤其里面有一门追风剑的武技，练至大成，出剑如风，旁人难见剑影，更是让林潜觉得不错。
时间流逝，很快外面就快到黄昏，林潜却还在这里翻看，基本上这里的秘籍他都翻看得七七八八了。
“有七八本都看起来不错......”
林潜心底还在衡量到底选择哪一本时，随手拿起书架最角落的一本秘籍，上面布满灰尘，隐约还能看清上面名字。
林潜只是看了一眼，就整个人猛的一震，目中露出振奋与激动，感觉这就是他要找的武技。

“无影针。”
他深吸一口气，将秘籍上的灰尘拍掉，仔细的看了看这武技的介绍，知道这是一本暗器秘籍，若能到了大成，可以在几十米外杀敌人于无形，敌人还没察觉到，就死了。
“这算不算异界的手枪，还是无声的。”
林潜拿着秘籍傻笑着，脑海里已经畅想着自己手一挥，敌人就倒下的场景。
content_en:
Cangyunmen's Gonggong Hall is located on the right side of the sect's meeting hall, about a hundred meters away.
There is a majestic stone lion on the left and right sides of the Chuangong Hall gate. The Chuangong Hall gate is gray-black and made of pure iron.
There is a plaque hanging high above the gate, with black characters on a yellow background and three big characters written like dragons and phoenixes: "Chuangong Hall."
It gives people a solemn atmosphere.
Pass through the gate and enter the Chuangong Hall. Walk along the corridor for about 20 meters, and you will see a five-story tower.
The tower is made of hard granite, with a row of iron bars installed at the windows to allow ventilation.
If you want to use your superb lightness skills to enter the Chuan Gong Building through the window, you will never be able to do so. You can only enter through the main entrance of the building.
Lin Qian stood under the Chuan Gong Building, looking up at the Chuan Gong Building with a look of amazement.
When Lin Qian first entered the building, he saw this tower from a distance and was shocked.
Now that I look at it up close, I feel how insignificant I am.
There was a wooden table at the door, and an old man with a rosy complexion sat behind it, slowly drinking tea.
Every disciple who passes by him will take out his identity plate and show it to the old man. After confirming that it is correct, he respectfully enters the power transmission building.
Lin Qian took a deep breath and came to the gate. Lin Qian followed the example of other disciples and respectfully handed over his identity plate.
"Well, Apprentice of the Alchemy Hall? You are an apprentice of the Alchemy Hall. What are you doing here?"
Looking at the nameplate handed over by Lin Qian, the old man's eyes narrowed and he asked doubtfully.
"Yes, I am an apprentice in the Medicine Refining Hall, but I am also an outer disciple, so I also want to learn martial arts."
Lin Qian replied respectfully.
The old man was a little curious and asked: "You don't want to study medicine and medicine properly, and why do you come here to learn martial arts?"
"Studying medicine and practicing martial arts require a lot of time. Can you learn it?"
"My main purpose is to study medicine, but sometimes I need to relax, so I wanted to come here to see if there are any suitable martial arts. When I relax, I can practice to relieve my mood, and it can also strengthen my body and prolong my life."
Lin Qian looked at the old man and said seriously.
"Then go in and take a look."
After hearing what Lin Qian said, the old man stopped asking any more questions.
Mainly because the old man saw that Lin Qian was so young and was studying medicine and practicing martial arts, and he was worried that he was not a master of time management. In the end, not only did he not learn medical skills well, he also failed to practice martial arts well. He ended up in vain and wasted his youth.
Although the medicine refining hall mainly focuses on treating diseases, healing injuries, and making medicines, there are actually some doctors who know some martial arts for self-protection.
Hall Master Liu of the Medicine Refining Hall is one of the best. Not only is his medical skills superb, but his martial arts skills are not inferior to those of the other hall masters, and he even has the upper hand.
...
There are not many bookshelves here, only about seven or eight.
There are secret books scattered on it. At a glance, there are dozens of them.
It's normal to think about it. It's just that for a sect near the county town, it's pretty good to have so many martial arts skills.
These martial arts are collected by the sect from various places over the years, otherwise there wouldn't be so many.
There are also some secret books that are presented to the sect by the disciples. The sect will naturally not take things from the disciples in vain. The disciples can choose a comparable martial arts secret book from the sect or give them money or medicine for practicing martial arts.
Lin Qian randomly picked up a secret book and read it, and found that these secret books on the bookshelf actually did not contain moves or training methods. They only had the names of martial arts, martial arts moves, and introduction to the advantages and disadvantages of martial arts.
Only after the disciple has actually chosen the secret book, will the real cultivation secret book be given to the disciple.
Lin Qian began to wander among the bookshelves, sometimes picking up sword-related martial arts, sometimes picking up secret books about knives and looking through them. Looking at the various secret books inside, he was very excited about every secret book and wished he could learn them all.
In particular, there is a martial art called Chasing the Wind Sword. After practicing it to perfection, the sword is like the wind, and it is difficult for others to see the shadow of the sword, which makes Lin Qian feel good.
Time passes, and soon it will be outsideAt dusk, Lin Qian was still reading here. Basically, he had read all the secret books here.
"There are seven or eight books that all look good..."
While Lin Qian was still weighing which book to choose, he picked up a secret book in the corner of the bookshelf. It was covered with dust, and the name on it could still be vaguely read.
Lin Qian just glanced at it, and his whole body was shaken, with excitement and excitement in his eyes. He felt that this was the martial skill he was looking for.
"Shadowless Needle."
He took a deep breath, dusted off the secret book, and carefully read the introduction to the martial arts. He knew that this was a hidden weapon secret book. If he could reach the Dacheng level, he could kill the enemy invisibly from dozens of meters away. The enemy would die before they noticed it.
"Whether this is a pistol from another world or not, it is silent."
Lin Qian held the secret book and smiled stupidly, already imagining in his mind the scene where the enemy fell down with a wave of his hand.
